title: Integrative multi-omics analysis uncovers a novel FOSL2-COL8A1-EMT regulatory axis driving colorectal cancer progression.
authors: Zhang, Xingyu; Yu, Teng; Li, Xiuming; Zou, Xun; Song, Yizhuo; Liu, Lin; Shen, Xiaozhu; Liu, Shunfang; Liu, Bin
one_liner_zh: 该文通过多组学与机器学习识别FOSL2转录因子直接结合COL8A1启动子并驱动结直肠癌EMT进程，虽涉及TF-DNA结合机制但以湿实验验证为主，AI/物理模拟方法深度有限。
abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) remains a leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide, with metastasis and therapeutic resistance driven in part by activation of epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT). However, the upstream regulatory networks sustaining EMT programs in CRC are not fully understood. Here, through an integrative multi-omics strategy combining cross-cohort transcriptomic analysis, machine learning-based feature prioritization, and functional validation, we identify COL8A1, a nonfibrillar type VIII collagen, as a critical EMT effector and oncogenic regulator in CRC. COL8A1 was consistently overexpressed across independent CRC datasets and correlated with advanced tumor stage, poor patient survival, and strong enrichment of EMT-related transcriptional programs. Mechanistically, we demonstrate that FOSL2, an AP-1 family transcription factor, directly binds to a conserved high-affinity motif within the COL8A1 promoter and transcriptionally activates its expression. FOSL2 and COL8A1 exhibit strong co-expression at both mRNA and protein levels in CRC specimens, and FOSL2 silencing suppresses COL8A1 expression. Functionally, COL8A1 promotes mesenchymal phenotypes, enhances CRC cell migration and invasion in vitro, and promotes tumor growth in vivo. Collectively, our findings uncover a previously unrecognized FOSL2-COL8A1-EMT regulatory axis that fuels CRC progression and metastasis, providing novel mechanistic insights into EMT maintenance and nominating COL8A1 as a promising prognostic biomarker and therapeutic target for advanced colorectal cancer.
abstract_zh: 结直肠癌（CRC）仍是全球癌症相关死亡的主要原因，其转移和治疗耐药部分由上皮-间质转化（EMT）的激活驱动。然而，维持CRC中EMT程序的上游调控网络尚未完全阐明。本研究通过整合多组学策略，结合跨队列转录组分析、基于机器学习的特征优先排序及功能验证，我们鉴定出COL8A1（一种非纤维状VIII型胶原蛋白）作为CRC中的关键EMT效应因子和致癌调控因子。COL8A1在多个独立CRC数据集中持续过表达，并与晚期肿瘤分期、患者生存率低及EMT相关转录程序的显著富集相关。机制上，我们证明FOSL2（AP-1家族转录因子）直接结合COL8A1启动子内的保守高亲和力基序，并转录激活其表达。FOSL2和COL8A1在CRC标本的mRNA和蛋白水平均表现出强共表达，且FOSL2沉默抑制COL8A1表达。功能上，COL8A1促进间质表型，增强CRC细胞体外迁移和侵袭能力，并促进体内肿瘤生长。综上，我们的发现揭示了一个此前未被识别的FOSL2-COL8A1-EMT调控轴，驱动CRC进展和转移，为EMT维持提供了新的机制见解，并将COL8A1列为晚期结直肠癌的有前景的预后生物标志物和治疗靶点。
